notes.content: All undergraduate programs within the College of Business have officially been designated as impacted . Students interested in becoming Business Administration majors must complete a supplemental application to the major and complete the following prerequisite requirements: ACCY 1, ACCY 2, ECON 1A, ECON 1B, MATH 24, MGMT 10, MIS 10, and STAT 1. All prerequisite courses must be completed with a minimum "C-" grade or higher, with the exception of MATH 24, which requires a minimum grade of "C" or better. All pre-majors must demonstrate spreadsheet competency by completing MIS 10. MATH 24 requires a minimum grade of "C" or better. AP Calculus with a score of 3 or above or any college-level Calculus course (NOT Pre-Calculus) will be accepted in lieu of MATH 24. The Associate Degree for Transfer (ADT) in Business Administration 2.0 is compatible with the B.S. in Business Administration - General Management concentration. Students pursuing the Associate Degree for Transfer must complete all lower-division major coursework with a "C" or better. Foreign Language Graduation Requirement Exemption: Students graduating with a Bachelor of Science in Business Administration (all concentrations) will not be subject to the University's Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. Students who change major may be subject to the University's Foreign Language Graduation Requirement. For information on the COB's Academic Policies (including grading and repeat policies), please visit: COB Academic Policies . For information on the COB's Program requirements, please visit: COB Program Requirements . For additional information, please visit: College of Business .
